Subject: Re: sizing calc for FinPay — 16k + reranker

Rafael / Monica — I ran the numbers with the latest bench results. Assumptions below:

- 16k model (mixed int8) sustained throughput: ~18 tokens/sec per A100-40 for 2048 avg request after KV reuse; effective tokens/sec falls to ~9 tok/s when context is full and attention cost rises.
- Reranker (smaller encoder) can do ~1200 rps per GPU for short contexts; typical cost is 8-12ms per call in bench.
- Expected workload: 1.2M tokens/day ~ 14 tok/s average, peak 120 qps with median request token count ~320.

Sizing proposal (conservative):
- 12 GPUs assigned to the generation pool (A100-40 equivalence) — covers steady-state with 1.5x headroom for caching efficiency.
- 2 GPUs assigned to reranker pool with autoscale burst up to 4 GPUs for spikes.
- Add a burst buffer of shared capacity (3 GPUs) in the same reserved tenancy for <5% of traffic during peak; billed at a reduced hourly rate in the commitment.

I'll attach the exact spreadsheet with hourly token models. If we go with 12+2+3 config, p50/p95 latency targets look achievable with caching and continuous batching.

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Capacity addendum: sizing for 16k model + reranker add-on

Hannah / Marcus — attaching a draft capacity addendum and the GPU sizing workbook for review. Key callouts in the addendum:

- Term: 12 months with option to extend at the agreed committed rate.
- Commit: monthly reserved GPUs (12 gen / 2 reranker / 3 shared burst) with a defined burst pool billing at 40% of committed rate for pre-agreed hours per month.
- Throughput guarantees: p50 latency <= 120ms for generation; p95 <= 250ms for worst-case long-context windows. Reranker commit guarantees median latency <= 40ms at 70% of commit level.
- Model variants: baseline (8k quantized) included; 16k variant is considered a billable add-on in this amendment.
- Canary & rollback: automatic fallback to 8k model variant if the 16k variant exceeds error/regression thresholds during rollout — no SLA credit unless outage > 15 mins across region.

Open items for procurement: exact pricing per GPU/month, overage rates, and DocuSign pathing. Rafael will follow up on pricing.

Best,
Monica
